overview_description.description: PostHog provides an open‑source platform for product analytics, combining tools such as event tracking, session replay, surveys, error monitoring, and feature flag management into a unified system. It enables teams to deploy feature flags with multivariate options, scheduled releases, early access control, and cross‑project syncing, while integrating playback and analytics for testing and rollout validation. The platform supports running A/B experiments, collecting qualitative feedback via surveys, and tracking errors alongside data pipelines and data warehouse connectors. It also offers lightweight AI-powered assistance and observability features tailored to product and development workflows. This toolkit is organized under a cohesive product OS that emphasizes open development practices, transparency of roadmap, and community contributions.

about_short_description.short_description: PostHog is an open source platform that helps build successful products by providing tools to evaluate feature impact and customer value.

product.name: Product Analytics
product.description: A tool for analyzing user behavior through event-based analytics, cohorts, and conversion funnels with auto capture and SQL access.

product.name: Session Replay
product.description: A feature that records and replays user sessions to observe user interactions and behaviors within a product.

product.name: Feature Flags
product.description: A system to control feature rollout by enabling or disabling features for specific user groups or conditions.

product.name: Experiments
product.description: A tool for running A/B tests and experiments to evaluate the impact of product changes on user behavior.

product.name: Surveys
product.description: A service to collect user feedback through surveys integrated into product workflows or emails.

product.name: Product Tours
product.description: A feature to create guided walkthroughs within a product to onboard or educate users.
